title: A footprint with rounded rectangle pads, a trapezoid pad and a mounting hole, placed twice (once turned)
how: Two footprints with the same name and the same pads once the turn of the part is taken off the angle of each pad (90 - 90 = 0 for U2): one footprint of the model, 2 components;
the footprint has 4 pads: two `roundrect` (read as a rectangle with the roundness kept), a `trapezoid` and a `np_thru_hole` with a drill of 2.2 mm = 4 pads, so 4 x 2 = 8 placed pads;
nets: GND and SIG = 2; pads with a net in each part: 1 (SIG), 2 (GND) and 3 (GND), the hole has none = 3 x 2 = 6 pad nets;
only the trapezoid has a shape that the model does not hold; the footprint is built once, so 1 pad with a simpler shape;
each part draws one `fp_circle` on the courtyard, which is not kept = 2 dropped graphics (the fields reference and value are not counted);
a `gr_rect` on Edge.Cuts is a ring of 4 points.
